as_written_in_papers.quote: TNFAIP3 mutation described as, TNFAIP3 NM_001270507.1:c.2199 C>A. p.(Cys733*), Transcript: Transcript: ENST00000612899.5, cDNA: c.2197–2199, Strand: +, Exon: Exon 9 of 9.
This nonsense mutation occurs on the plus strand in exon 9 of 9 at chromosome 6: position 137,881,145 (GRCh38/hg38).

cases.statement: One person: a 13-year-old Colombian girl with Cornelia de Lange syndrome features and generalized pustular psoriasis, carrying a RAD21 nonsense variant and this TNFAIP3 variant (clinical exome).

people.label: patient
people.other_allele: not applicable (second-gene variant: RAD21 c.1306C>T p.(Gln436*))
people.key_phenotypes: pustular psoriasis (histology) progressing to erythroderma; Cornelia de Lange features (synophrys, micrognathia, short stature, upper-limb reduction defects); dysprosody and limited social interaction

quotes.quote: Histopathology confirmed pustular psoriasis, and clinical exome sequencing identified a heterozygous likely pathogenic variant in RAD21, associated with CdLS type 4 (CdLS4), and a heterozygous variant of uncertain significance in TNFAIP3, which is linked to familial autoinflammatory syndrome.
The proband is a 13-year-old female, Colombian, born from a vanishing twin pregnancy, with a maternal history of cleft palate.
These findings confirmed the diagnosis of pustular psoriasis.
Neurocognitive features include dysprosody and limited social interaction.

phenotype_specificity.statement: The phenotype is pustular psoriasis with a developmental syndrome explained by a RAD21 variant; Behçet-like ulcers, fever or other HA20 features are not described. The authors present the case as hypothesis-generating.

quotes.quote: Based on the constellation of findings, the initial clinical impression included pustular psoriasis versus DITRA syndrome, associated with Cornelia de Lange syndrome.

Our work should therefore be viewed as an initial step to open new avenues for investigation and hypothesis generation regarding overlapping developmental and inflammatory disorders, rather than providing definitive evidence [83].

de_novo.statement: A figure legend calls the TNFAIP3 variant de novo, but the text describes no parental testing.

quotes.quote: Characterization of a de novo heterozygous TNFAIP3 nonsense mutation in the proband.

functional.statement: No wet-lab assay of the variant. AlphaFold 3 structural modelling of the truncated protein showed less misalignment than the RAD21 mutant; a public GEO dataset on RAD21 knockdown (not this patient) was analysed.

quotes.quote: Alignment analysis of TNFAIP3 WT vs. TNFAIP3 Mutant p.(Cys733*) showed comparatively a less disrupted alignment assed by yellow lines within the two molecules (Figure 4b).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Nonsense: c.2199C>A predicted p.(Cys733Ter), in the last exon (exon 9 of 9), removing the final 57 amino acids. The authors say the transcript may escape NMD and propose loss of function.

quotes.quote: Given its location in the terminal exon, the altered transcript may evade nonsense-mediated decay (NMD), and produce a truncated but nonfunctional protein, consistent with a dominant loss-of-function mechanism seen in HA20 [11].

The truncation at amino acid 733 (highlighted by a red dashed line) disrupts the final ZnF_A20 domain, removing the last 57 amino acids, which may impair the protein’s regulatory role in ubiquitin editing and NF-κB signaling.

computational_predictions.statement: Conservation across vertebrates on a UCSC multispecies alignment; structural modelling as above. No SIFT, PolyPhen or CADD values.

quotes.quote: Multispecies alignment demonstrates conservation of the affected nucleotide across vertebrates, supporting potential functional importance.

authors_classification.statement: The authors classify it as a variant of uncertain significance (ACMG/AMP), also citing ClinVar and the UniProt variant viewer.

quotes.quote: According to the ACMG/AMP guidelines [28] and ClinVar [29], it is currently classified as a variant of uncertain significance.
TNFAIP3 variant viewer showed CYS 733 in green line as a variant of uncertain significance (Figure 4d).

concerns: The paper uses NM_001270507.1 (and ENST00000612899.5); the batch HGVS is on NM_001270508.2. The protein agrees (protein_check: agrees), and the paper's GRCh38 position 137,881,145 matches the batch VCF.
Another candidate variant in the same person: RAD21 c.1306C>T p.(Gln436*), which explains the Cornelia de Lange features.
The paper contradicts itself: it cites a ClinVar classification for the variant, but later says the variant is not documented in ClinVar Miner listings.
The paper says the variant changes a 'Glycine' to a stop codon in one sentence and a cysteine elsewhere.
De novo status appears only in a figure legend; no parental testing is described.
The paper's own classification statement cites a ClinVar record, so it is not independent of the database.
notes_for_panel: Single case with a co-occurring RAD21 variant; the phenotype (pustular psoriasis) is not the typical HA20 picture. Last-exon truncation, so the NMD argument does not apply; the evidence is in-silico only.
